translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang succeeded to the throne he greatly expanded military equipment. Because Pi was clever by nature and practiced in old affairs, an edict put him in charge of this duty.

sentences.zh: 尋授朝請郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 毗立議，輦輅車輿，多所增損。

translations.literal: Pi proposed regulations for imperial carriages and conveyances with many additions and reductions.
translations.idiomatic: Pi proposed regulations for imperial carriages and conveyances with many additions and reductions.

sentences.zh: 擢拜起部郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted and appointed Gentleman of the Ministry of Construction.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted and appointed Gentleman of the Ministry of Construction.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗大備法駕，嫌屬車太多，顧謂毗曰：「開皇之日，屬車十二乘，於事亦得。

translations.literal: The emperor once fully prepared the imperial guard of honor and, disliking the excessive number of attendant carriages, turned to Pi and said: "In the Kaihuang era twelve attendant carriages were enough for the purpose.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once fully prepared the imperial guard of honor and, disliking the excessive number of attendant carriages, turned to Pi and said, "In the Kaihuang era twelve attendant carriages were enough for the purpose.

sentences.zh: 今八十一乘，以牛駕車，不足以益文物，朕欲減之，從何為可？」

translations.literal: Now there are eighty-one, with oxen drawing the carriages—not enough to enhance ceremonial display. I wish to reduce them; from what should I begin?"
translations.idiomatic: Now there are eighty-one, with oxen drawing the carriages—not enough to enhance ceremonial display. I wish to reduce them. From what should I begin?

sentences.zh: 毗曰：「臣初定數，共宇文愷參詳故實，據漢胡伯始、蔡邕等議，屬車八十一乘。

translations.literal: Pi said: "When I first fixed the number, together with Yuwen Kai I examined ancient precedent; according to the deliberations of Hu Boshi and Cai Yong of Han and others, attendant carriages numbered eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Pi said, "When I first fixed the number, together with Yuwen Kai I examined ancient precedent. According to the deliberations of Hu Boshi and Cai Yong of Han and others, attendant carriages numbered eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 此起于秦，遂為後式。

translations.literal: This began in Qin and thus became the later model.
translations.idiomatic: This began in Qin and thus became the later model.

sentences.zh: 故張衡賦雲'屬車九九'是也。

translations.literal: Therefore Zhang Heng's rhapsody says 'attendant carriages nine by nine'—that is the point.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Zhang Heng's rhapsody says 'attendant carriages nine by nine'—that is the point.

sentences.zh: 次及法駕，三分減一，為三十六乘，此漢制也。

translations.literal: Next for the secondary guard of honor, reduce by one-third to thirty-six carriages—this is the Han system.
translations.idiomatic: Next for the secondary guard of honor, reduce by one-third to thirty-six carriages—this is the Han system.

sentences.zh: 又據宋孝建時，有司奏議，晉遷江左，唯設五乘，尚書令建平王宏曰：「八十一乘，義兼六國，三十六乘，無所准憑，江左五乘，儉不中禮。

translations.literal: Also according to the memorial deliberation in the Xiaojian era of Song, when Jin moved to the lands east of the Yangtze only five carriages were set up; Prince Hong of Jianping, Director of the Department of State Affairs, said: "Eighty-one carriages combine the meaning of the Six States; thirty-six carriages have no basis; the five carriages of the lands east of the Yangtze are too austere and not in accord with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Also according to the memorial deliberation in the Xiaojian era of Song, when Jin moved to the lands east of the Yangtze only five carriages were set up. Prince Hong of Jianping, Director of the Department of State Affairs, said, "Eighty-one carriages combine the meaning of the Six States; thirty-six carriages have no basis; the five carriages of the lands east of the Yangtze are too austere and not in accord with ritual.

sentences.zh: 但帝王文物旗旒之數，爰及冕玉，皆用十二，今宜准此，設十二乘。

translations.literal: But the numbers for imperial ceremonial objects, banners, and pennants, extending to the crown and jade, all use twelve; now it is appropriate to follow this and set twelve carriages.
translations.idiomatic: But the numbers for imperial ceremonial objects, banners, and pennants, extending to the crown and jade, all use twelve. Now it is appropriate to follow this and set twelve carriages.

sentences.zh: '開皇平陳，因以為法。

translations.literal: When Kaihuang pacified Chen, this was taken as the law.
translations.idiomatic: When Kaihuang pacified Chen, this was taken as the law.

sentences.zh: 今憲章往古，大駕依秦，法駕依漢，小駕依宋，以為差等。」

translations.literal: Now taking the statutes of antiquity as model, the great guard of honor follows Qin, the secondary guard follows Han, and the lesser guard follows Song, establishing the gradations."
translations.idiomatic: Now taking the statutes of antiquity as model, the great guard of honor follows Qin, the secondary guard follows Han, and the lesser guard follows Song, establishing the gradations."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「何用秦法！

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Why use Qin law!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Why use Qin law!

sentences.zh: 大駕宜三十六，法駕宜十二，小駕除之。」

translations.literal: The great guard of honor should be thirty-six, the secondary guard twelve, and the lesser guard abolished."
translations.idiomatic: The great guard of honor should be thirty-six, the secondary guard twelve, and the lesser guard abolished."

sentences.zh: 毗研精故事，皆此類也。

translations.literal: Pi studied ancient precedent with great precision; all his proposals were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Pi studied ancient precedent with great precision. All his proposals were of this kind.

sentences.zh: 長城之役，毗總其事。

translations.literal: For the Great Wall project, Pi supervised the affair.
translations.idiomatic: For the Great Wall project, Pi supervised the affair.

sentences.zh: 及帝有事恆嶽，詔毗營立壇場。

translations.literal: When the emperor performed rites at Mount Heng, an edict ordered Pi to construct and establish the altar platform.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor performed rites at Mount Heng, an edict ordered Pi to construct and establish the altar platform.

sentences.zh: 尋轉殿內丞，從幸張掖郡。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Palace Attendant and followed on an imperial visit to Zhangye Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Palace Attendant and followed on an imperial visit to Zhangye Commandery.

sentences.zh: 高昌王朝於行所，詔毗持節迎勞，遂將護入東都。

translations.literal: When the king of Gaochang came to pay court at the traveling palace, an edict ordered Pi to go with staff of authority to welcome and comfort him, and he then escorted the king into the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the king of Gaochang came to pay court at the traveling palace, an edict ordered Pi to go with staff of authority to welcome and comfort him, and he then escorted the king into the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 尋以母憂去職，未期，起令視事。

translations.literal: Soon because of his mother's mourning he left office; before the mourning period ended he was recalled and ordered to resume duties.
translations.idiomatic: Soon because of his mother's mourning he left office. Before the mourning period ended he was recalled and ordered to resume duties.

sentences.zh: 將興遼東之役，自洛口開渠達涿郡以通漕，毗督其役。

translations.literal: When the campaign against Liaodong was about to begin, a canal was opened from Luokou to reach Zhuo Commandery for transport; Pi supervised the labor.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign against Liaodong was about to begin, a canal was opened from Luokou to reach Zhuo Commandery for transport. Pi supervised the labor.

sentences.zh: 明年，兼領右翊衛長史，營建臨朔宮。

translations.literal: The following year he additionally served as Chief Administrator of the Right Wing Guard and supervised construction of Linshuo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he additionally served as Chief Administrator of the Right Wing Guard and supervised construction of Linshuo Palace.

sentences.zh: 及征遼東，以本官領武賁郎將，典宿衛。

translations.literal: When the campaign against Liaodong began, in his existing office he additionally served as Captain of the Martial Guard and managed palace guard duty.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign against Liaodong began, in his existing office he additionally served as Captain of the Martial Guard and managed palace guard duty.

sentences.zh: 時軍圍遼東城，帝令毗詣城下宣諭，賊弓弩亂髮，流矢中所乘馬，毗顏色不變，辭氣抑揚，卒事而去。

translations.literal: At that time the army besieged Liaodong city; the emperor ordered Pi to go below the walls to proclaim the imperial message. The enemy's bows and crossbows fired wildly; a stray arrow struck the horse he rode, but Pi's expression did not change and his tone rose and fell with composure; he finished the task and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the army besieged Liaodong city. The emperor ordered Pi to go below the walls to proclaim the imperial message. The enemy's bows and crossbows fired wildly and a stray arrow struck his horse, but Pi's expression did not change and his tone rose and fell with composure. He finished the task and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遷殿內少監，又領將作少監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Junior Palace Attendant and additionally served as Junior Supervisor of Construction.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Junior Palace Attendant and additionally served as Junior Supervisor of Construction.

sentences.zh: 後復從帝征遼東。

translations.literal: Later he again followed the emperor on campaign against Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again followed the emperor on campaign against Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 會楊玄感作逆，帝班師，從至高陽郡，卒。

translations.literal: When Yang Xuangan rebelled, the emperor withdrew the army; Pi followed to Gaoyang Commandery and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Xuangan rebelled, the emperor withdrew the army. Pi followed to Gaoyang Commandery and died.

sentences.zh: 帝甚悼惜之，贈殿內監。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply mourned and regretted this and posthumously granted him Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply mourned and regretted this and posthumously granted him Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 史寧，字永和，建康表氏人也。

translations.literal: Shi Ning, courtesy name Yonghe, was a man of the Biao clan of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Ning, courtesy name Yonghe, was a man of the Biao clan of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 曾祖豫，仕沮渠氏為臨松令。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Yu served the Juqu clan as Governor of Linsong.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Yu served the Juqu clan as Governor of Linsong.

sentences.zh: 魏平涼州，祖灌隨例遷于撫寧鎮，因家焉。

translations.literal: When Wei pacified Liang Province, his grandfather Guan moved according to precedent to Funing Garrison and made his home there.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei pacified Liang Province, his grandfather Guan moved according to precedent to Funing Garrison and made his home there.

sentences.zh: 父遵，初為征虜府鎧曹參軍。

translations.literal: His father Zun at first served as Army Master of Armor in the Pacification of Barbarians Office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zun at first served as Army Master of Armor in the Pacification of Barbarians Office.

sentences.zh: 杜洛周構逆，六鎮自相屠隱，遵遂率鄉里奔恆州。

translations.literal: When Du Luozhou plotted rebellion and the Six Garrisons slaughtered one another, Zun then led his home region to flee to Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Du Luozhou plotted rebellion and the Six Garrisons slaughtered one another, Zun then led his home region to flee to Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 其後恆州為賊所敗，遵後歸洛陽，拜樓煩郡守。

translations.literal: Afterward Heng Province was defeated by bandits; Zun later returned to Luoyang and was appointed Governor of Loufan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Heng Province was defeated by bandits. Zun later returned to Luoyang and was appointed Governor of Loufan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及寧著勳，贈散騎常侍、征西大將軍、涼州刺史，諡曰貞。

translations.literal: When Ning achieved merit, Zun was posthumously granted Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Grand General of the Western Expedition, and Governor of Liang Province; posthumous title Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: When Ning achieved merit, Zun was posthumously granted Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Grand General of the Western Expedition, and Governor of Liang Province, with the posthumous name Zhen, "Upright."

sentences.zh: 甯少以軍功，累加持節、征東將軍、金光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Ning from youth achieved merit through military service and was repeatedly granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of the Eastern Expedition, and Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with the Gold Seal.
translations.idiomatic: Ning from youth achieved merit through military service and was repeatedly granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of the Eastern Expedition, and Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with the Gold Seal.

sentences.zh: 賀拔勝為荊州刺史，甯以本官為勝軍司，隨勝之部。

translations.literal: When Helba Sheng was Governor of Jing Province, Ning in his existing office served as Sheng's army secretary and followed Sheng's command.
translations.idiomatic: When Helba Sheng was Governor of Jing Province, Ning in his existing office served as Sheng's army secretary and followed Sheng's command.

sentences.zh: 會荊蠻騷動，三鵶路絕。

translations.literal: It happened that the Jing barbarians were in turmoil and the Sanya route was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Jing barbarians were in turmoil and the Sanya route was cut off.

sentences.zh: 甯先驅平之，因撫慰蠻左，翕然降附。

translations.literal: Ning as vanguard pacified them and thereby comforted the barbarian regions; they all submitted in good order.
translations.idiomatic: Ning as vanguard pacified them and thereby comforted the barbarian regions. They all submitted in good order.

sentences.zh: 尋除南郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Southern Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Governor of Southern Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 及勝為大行台，表甯為大都督。

translations.literal: When Sheng became Grand Commissioner, he memorialized recommending Ning as Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng became Grand Commissioner, he memorialized recommending Ning as Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 攻梁下溠戍破之，封武平縣伯。

translations.literal: He attacked and broke Liang's Xiatao garrison and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wuping County.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked and broke Liang's Xiatao garrison and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wuping County.

sentences.zh: 又攻拔梁齊興鎮等九城。

translations.literal: He also attacked and captured nine cities including Liang's Qixing garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He also attacked and captured nine cities including Liang's Qixing garrison.

sentences.zh: 未及論功，屬孝武西遷，東魏遣侯景寇荊州，寧隨勝奔梁。

translations.literal: Before merit could be assessed, Emperor Xiaowu moved west; Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing to raid Jing Province; Ning followed Sheng and fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Before merit could be assessed, Emperor Xiaowu moved west. Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing to raid Jing Province, and Ning followed Sheng and fled to Liang.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝引寧至香蹬前，謂之曰：「觀卿風表，終是富貴，我當使卿衣錦還鄉。」

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang led Ning before the incense platform and said to him: "Judging by your bearing, you are destined for wealth and honor; I shall make you return home in brocade robes."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang led Ning before the incense platform and said to him, "Judging by your bearing, you are destined for wealth and honor. I shall make you return home in brocade robes.

sentences.zh: 寧答曰：「臣世荷魏恩，位為列將，天長喪亂，本朝傾覆，不能北面事逆賊，幸得息肩有道。

translations.literal: Ning answered: "Your servant for generations has received Wei's grace and holds the rank of a commander. Heaven has long been in chaos and the former dynasty has fallen; I could not serve the rebel enemy facing north, and am fortunate to find rest under a righteous ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Ning answered, "Your servant for generations has received Wei's grace and holds the rank of a commander. Heaven has long been in chaos and the former dynasty has fallen. I could not serve the rebel enemy facing north, and am fortunate to find rest under a righteous ruler.

sentences.zh: 儻如明詔，欣幸實多。」

translations.literal: If it accords with your bright decree, my joy and fortune would indeed be great."
translations.idiomatic: If it accords with your bright decree, my joy and fortune would indeed be great."

sentences.zh: 因涕泣橫流，梁武為之動容。

translations.literal: Thereupon tears streamed down his face and Emperor Wu of Liang was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon tears streamed down his face and Emperor Wu of Liang was moved.

sentences.zh: 在梁二年，勝乃與寧密圖歸計。

translations.literal: After two years in Liang, Sheng then secretly plotted a plan to return with Ning.
translations.idiomatic: After two years in Liang, Sheng then secretly plotted a plan to return with Ning.

sentences.zh: 寧曰：「硃異既為梁主所信任，請往見之。」

translations.literal: Ning said: "Zhu Yi is trusted by the Liang ruler; I ask to go see him."
translations.idiomatic: Ning said, "Zhu Yi is trusted by the Liang ruler. I ask to go see him.

sentences.zh: 勝然其言。

translations.literal: Sheng agreed with his words.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng agreed with his words.

sentences.zh: 甯乃見異，申以投分之言，微托思歸之意，辭氣雅至。

translations.literal: Ning then saw Yi and expressed words of shared commitment, subtly entrusting his wish to return; his tone was elegant and perfect.
translations.idiomatic: Ning then saw Yi and expressed words of shared commitment, subtly entrusting his wish to return. His tone was elegant and perfect.

sentences.zh: 異亦嗟挹，為奏梁主，果許勝等歸。

translations.literal: Yi also sighed in admiration and memorialized the Liang ruler; indeed permission was granted for Sheng and the others to return.
translations.idiomatic: Yi also sighed in admiration and memorialized the Liang ruler. Indeed permission was granted for Sheng and the others to return.

sentences.zh: 大統二年，自梁歸，進爵為侯。

translations.literal: In the second year of Datong he returned from Liang and was advanced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Datong he returned from Liang and was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷車騎將軍，行涇州事。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to Grand Master of Chariots and Cavalry and administered Jing Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to Grand Master of Chariots and Cavalry and administered Jing Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 時賊帥莫折後熾寇掠居人，寧率州兵與行原州事李賢討破之。

translations.literal: At that time the bandit chief Moqi Houchi raided and plundered the inhabitants; Ning led provincial troops together with Li Xian, who administered Yuan Province affairs, to suppress and defeat him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the bandit chief Moqi Houchi raided and plundered the inhabitants. Ning led provincial troops together with Li Xian, who administered Yuan Province affairs, to suppress and defeat him.

sentences.zh: 轉東義州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Eastern Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of Eastern Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 東魏亦以胡梨苟為東義州刺史。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei also appointed Hu Ligou as Governor of Eastern Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei also appointed Hu Ligou as Governor of Eastern Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 寧僅得入州，梨苟亦至，寧逆擊破之，斬其洛安郡守馮善道。

translations.literal: Ning had barely entered the province when Ligou also arrived; Ning counterattacked and defeated him and beheaded his Governor of Luo'an Commandery, Feng Shandao.
translations.idiomatic: Ning had barely entered the province when Ligou also arrived. Ning counterattacked and defeated him and beheaded his Governor of Luo'an Commandery, Feng Shandao.

sentences.zh: 州既鄰接疆場，百姓流移，寧留心撫慰，咸來復業。

translations.literal: Since the province bordered the frontier and the common people were displaced, Ning devoted attention to comforting them and all returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Since the province bordered the frontier and the common people were displaced, Ning devoted attention to comforting them and all returned to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 轉涼州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 甯未至而前刺史宇文仲和據州作亂，詔獨孤信與寧討之。

translations.literal: Before Ning arrived the former governor Yuwen Zhonghe held the province and rebelled; an edict ordered Dugu Xin and Ning to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Before Ning arrived the former governor Yuwen Zhonghe held the province and rebelled. An edict ordered Dugu Xin and Ning to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 甯先至涼州，為陳禍福，城中吏人皆相率降附。

translations.literal: Ning arrived at Liang Province first and set forth fortune and disaster; the clerks and commoners in the city all in succession submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ning arrived at Liang Province first and set forth fortune and disaster. The clerks and commoners in the city all in succession submitted.

sentences.zh: 仲和仍據城不下，尋亦克之。

translations.literal: Zhonghe still held the city and would not submit; soon it was also taken.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe still held the city and would not submit. Soon it was also taken.

sentences.zh: 後遷驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，加侍中，進爵為公。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to General of Agile Cavalry, Director of the Department of State Affairs with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, additionally made Palace Attendant, and advanced in rank to duke.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to General of Agile Cavalry, Director of the Department of State Affairs with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies, additionally appointed Palace Attendant, and advanced in rank to duke.

sentences.zh: 十六年，宕昌叛羌獠甘作亂，逐其王彌定而自立，並連結傍乞鐵匆及鄭五醜等。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the rebellious Qiang Liaogan of Dangchang raised turmoil, drove out his king Midin and set himself up, and also linked with the neighboring Qietiecong and Zheng Wuchou and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the rebellious Qiang Liaogan of Dangchang raised turmoil, drove out his king Midin and set himself up, and also linked with the neighboring Qietiecong and Zheng Wuchou and others.

sentences.zh: 詔甯率軍與宇文貴、豆盧寧等討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ning to lead troops together with Yuwen Gui, Dou Lu Ning, and others to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ning to lead troops together with Yuwen Gui, Dou Lu Ning, and others to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甯別擊獠甘，而山路險阻，才通單騎，獠甘已分其黨立柵守險。

translations.literal: Ning separately attacked Liaogan, but the mountain roads were perilous and steep and only single horsemen could pass; Liaogan had already divided his faction and set up stockades to hold the defiles.
translations.idiomatic: Ning separately attacked Liaogan, but the mountain roads were perilous and steep and only single horsemen could pass. Liaogan had already divided his faction and set up stockades to hold the defiles.

sentences.zh: 寧進兵攻之，遂破其柵。

translations.literal: Ning advanced his troops to attack and thereby broke their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Ning advanced his troops to attack and thereby broke their stockade.

sentences.zh: 獠甘將百騎走投生羌鞏廉玉。

translations.literal: Liaogan with a hundred horsemen fled in defeat to the raw Qiang Gong Lianyu.
translations.idiomatic: Liaogan with a hundred horsemen fled in defeat to the raw Qiang Gong Lianyu.

sentences.zh: 彌定遂得復位。

translations.literal: Midin was thereby able to regain his position.
translations.idiomatic: Midin was thereby able to regain his position.

sentences.zh: 甯以未獲獠甘，遂進軍大破之，生獲獠甘，徇而斬之。

translations.literal: Because Ning had not yet captured Liaogan, he then advanced his army and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Liaogan alive and executing him by parade.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ning had not yet captured Liaogan, he then advanced his army and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Liaogan alive and executing him by parade.

sentences.zh: 並執鞏廉玉送闕。

translations.literal: He also seized Gong Lianyu and sent him to court.
translations.idiomatic: He also seized Gong Lianyu and sent him to court.

sentences.zh: 所得軍實，悉分賞將士，寧無私焉。

translations.literal: The military goods obtained were all divided and rewarded to the generals and soldiers; Ning kept nothing for himself.
translations.idiomatic: The military goods obtained were all divided and rewarded to the generals and soldiers. Ning kept nothing for himself.

sentences.zh: 師還，召寧率所部鎮河陽。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Ning was summoned to lead his command and garrison Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Ning was summoned to lead his command and garrison Heyang.

sentences.zh: 時突厥木汗可汗假道涼州，將襲吐谷渾，周文令寧率騎隨之。

translations.literal: At that time the Turkic ruler Muhan Khan asked passage through Liang Province intending to raid the Tuyuhun; Zhou Wen ordered Ning to lead cavalry to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Turkic ruler Muhan Khan asked passage through Liang Province intending to raid the Tuyuhun. Emperor Wen ordered Ning to lead cavalry to follow him.

sentences.zh: 軍至番禾，吐谷渾已覺，奔于南山。

translations.literal: The army reached Fanhe; the Tuyuhun had already detected them and fled to the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Fanhe. The Tuyuhun had already detected them and fled to the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 木汗將分兵追之，令俱會于青海。

translations.literal: Muhan was about to divide his troops to pursue them and ordered all to meet at Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Muhan was about to divide his troops to pursue them and ordered all to meet at Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 寧謂木汗曰：「樹敦、賀真二城是吐谷渾巢穴，今若拔其本根，余種自然離散，此上也。」

translations.literal: Ning said to Muhan: "The two cities of Shudun and Hezhen are the nest of the Tuyuhun; if we now uproot their foundation, the remaining tribes will naturally scatter—this is the highest strategy."
translations.idiomatic: Ning said to Muhan, "The two cities of Shudun and Hezhen are the nest of the Tuyuhun. If we now uproot their foundation, the remaining tribes will naturally scatter—this is the highest strategy.

sentences.zh: 木汗從之，即分為兩軍，木汗從北道向賀真，寧趣樹敦。

translations.literal: Muhan followed this and immediately divided into two armies; Muhan took the northern route toward Hezhen and Ning hastened to Shudun.
translations.idiomatic: Muhan followed this and immediately divided into two armies. Muhan took the northern route toward Hezhen and Ning hastened to Shudun.

sentences.zh: 渾娑周王率眾逆戰，寧擊斬之。

translations.literal: Prince Suozhou of the Tuyuhun led the masses to oppose in battle; Ning struck and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Suozhou of the Tuyuhun led the masses to oppose in battle. Ning struck and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 逾山履險，遂至樹敦。

translations.literal: Crossing mountains and treading perilous paths, he then reached Shudun.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing mountains and treading perilous paths, he then reached Shudun.

sentences.zh: 樹敦是渾之舊都，多諸珍藏。

translations.literal: Shudun was the old capital of the Tuyuhun and held many treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Shudun was the old capital of the Tuyuhun and held many treasures.

sentences.zh: 而渾主先已奔賀真，留其征南王及數千人固守。

translations.literal: But the Tuyuhun ruler had already fled to Hezhen, leaving his Prince of the Southern Expedition and several thousand men to defend obstinately.
translations.idiomatic: But the Tuyuhun ruler had already fled to Hezhen, leaving his Prince of the Southern Expedition and several thousand men to defend obstinately.

sentences.zh: 寧進兵攻之，偽退，渾人果開門逐之，因回兵奮擊，門未及闔，寧兵遂得入。

translations.literal: Ning advanced his troops to attack and feigned retreat; the Tuyuhun indeed opened the gates to pursue, whereupon he turned his army and struck fiercely; before the gates could close, Ning's troops were able to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Ning advanced his troops to attack and feigned retreat. The Tuyuhun indeed opened the gates to pursue, whereupon he turned his army and struck fiercely. Before the gates could close, Ning's troops were able to enter.

sentences.zh: 生獲其征南王，俘虜男女財寶盡歸諸突厥。

translations.literal: He captured alive their Prince of the Southern Expedition; captives, men and women, and treasures all went to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: He captured alive their Prince of the Southern Expedition. Captives, men and women, and treasures all went to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 渾賀羅拔王依險為柵，欲塞甯路，寧攻破之。

translations.literal: Prince Heluoba of the Tuyuhun relied on the defiles to make a stockade, intending to block Ning's route; Ning broke through and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Heluoba of the Tuyuhun relied on the defiles to make a stockade, intending to block Ning's route. Ning broke through and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 木汗亦破賀真，虜渾主妻子，大獲珍物。

translations.literal: Muhan also broke Hezhen, captured the Tuyuhun ruler's wife and children, and gained great quantities of rare goods.
translations.idiomatic: Muhan also broke Hezhen, captured the Tuyuhun ruler's wife and children, and gained great quantities of rare goods.

sentences.zh: 甯還軍于青海，與木汗會。

translations.literal: Ning returned his army to Qinghai and met with Muhan.
translations.idiomatic: Ning returned his army to Qinghai and met with Muhan.

sentences.zh: 木汗握寧手，歎其勇決，並遺所乘良馬，令甯於帳前乘之，木汗親自步送。

translations.literal: Muhan grasped Ning's hand, admired his courage and decisiveness, and also gave him the fine horse he himself rode, ordering Ning to mount it before the tent; Muhan personally walked to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: Muhan grasped Ning's hand, admired his courage and decisiveness, and also gave him the fine horse he himself rode, ordering Ning to mount it before the tent. Muhan personally walked to escort him.

sentences.zh: 突厥以寧所圖必破，皆畏憚之，咸曰：「此中國神智人也。」

translations.literal: The Turks, because whatever Ning planned was sure to succeed, all feared and respected him and said: "This is a divinely wise man of China."
translations.idiomatic: The Turks, because whatever Ning planned was sure to succeed, all feared and respected him and said, "This is a divinely wise man of China.

sentences.zh: 及將班師，木汗又遺甯奴婢一百口、馬五百匹、羊一萬口。

translations.literal: When about to withdraw the army, Muhan again gave Ning a hundred male and female slaves, five hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: When about to withdraw the army, Muhan again gave Ning a hundred male and female slaves, five hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 寧乃還州，尋被征入朝。

translations.literal: Ning then returned to his province and was soon summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ning then returned to his province and was soon summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 屬周文帝崩，寧悲慟不已，乃請赴陵所盡哀，並告行師克捷。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Zhou died, Ning grieved immeasurably and requested to go to the tomb site to express full mourning and report the army's victorious campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Zhou died, Ning grieved immeasurably and requested to go to the tomb site to express full mourning and report the army's victorious campaign.

sentences.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，拜小司徒，出為荊州刺史、荊襄淅郢等五十二州及江陵鎮防諸軍事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Minister over the Masses and went out as Governor of Jing Province, Commander of Military Affairs in Fifty-two Provinces including Jing, Xiang, Xi, and Ying, and Walled Garrison of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Minister over the Masses and posted as Governor of Jing Province, Commander of Military Affairs in Fifty-two Provinces including Jing, Xiang, Xi, and Ying, and Walled Garrison of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 寧有謀畫，識兵權，臨敵指捴，皆如其策，甚得當時之譽。

translations.literal: Ning had stratagems and understood military authority; facing the enemy he directed operations and all went according to his plans; he won great renown in his time.
translations.idiomatic: Ning had stratagems and understood military authority. Facing the enemy he directed operations and all went according to his plans. He won great renown in his time.

sentences.zh: 及在荊州，頗自奢縱，貪濁不修法度。

translations.literal: When he was in Jing Province he was rather self-indulgent and luxurious, greedy and corrupt, and did not observe law and regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When he was in Jing Province he was rather self-indulgent and luxurious, greedy and corrupt, and did not observe law and regulation.

sentences.zh: 嘗出，有人訴州佐屈法，甯還付被訟者治之。

translations.literal: Once when he went out, someone sued a provincial aide for bending the law; Ning returned the case to the sued party to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Once when he went out, someone sued a provincial aide for bending the law. Ning returned the case to the sued party to handle.

sentences.zh: 自是有事者不敢復言，聲名大損於西州。

translations.literal: From then on those with grievances did not dare speak again; his reputation was greatly damaged in the western provinces.
translations.idiomatic: From then on those with grievances did not dare speak again. His reputation was greatly damaged in the western provinces.

sentences.zh: 保定三年，卒於州，諡曰烈。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoding he died in the province; posthumous title Lie.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Baoding he died in the province and was given the posthumous name Lie, "Fierce."

sentences.zh: 子雄嗣。

translations.literal: His son Xiong succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiong succeeded to the line.

sentences.zh: 雄字世武。

translations.literal: Xiong, courtesy name Shiwu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong, courtesy name Shiwu.

sentences.zh: 少勇敢，膂力過人，便弓馬，有算略。

translations.literal: From youth he was brave, his physical strength surpassed other men, he was skilled in bow and horse, and possessed stratagems.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was brave. His physical strength surpassed other men, he was skilled in archery and horsemanship, and possessed stratagems.

sentences.zh: 年十四，從甯於牽屯山奉迎周文帝。

translations.literal: At age fourteen he followed Ning at Qiantun Mountain to welcome Emperor Wen of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: At age fourteen he followed Ning at Qiantun Mountain to welcome Emperor Wen of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 仍從校獵，弓無虛發，周文歎異之。

translations.literal: He then followed on a hunting expedition; his bow never missed; Zhou Wen sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed on a hunting expedition. His bow never missed, and Emperor Wen sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 尋尚周文女永富公主。

translations.literal: Soon he married the daughter of Zhou Wen, Princess Yongfu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon married the daughter of Emperor Wen, Princess Yongfu.

sentences.zh: 除使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，累遷駕部中大夫、司馭中大夫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Director of the Department of State Affairs with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Chariot Department and Grand Master of the Horse Department.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Director of the Department of State Affairs with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Chariot Department and Grand Master of the Horse Department.

sentences.zh: 從柱國、枹罕公辛威鎮金城，遂卒于軍，時年二十四。

translations.literal: Following the Pillar of the State, Duke of Baohan Xin Wei in garrison at Jincheng, he then died in the army at age twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Following Xin Wei, Pillar of the State and Duke of Baohan, in garrison at Jincheng, he died in the army at the age of twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 雄弟祥。

translations.literal: Xiong's younger brother Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong's younger brother was Xiang.

sentences.zh: 祥字世休，少有文武才幹。

translations.literal: Xiang, courtesy name Shixiu, from youth had both civil and military talent and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang, courtesy name Shixiu, had both civil and military talent and ability from youth.

sentences.zh: 仕周，太子車右中士，襲爵武遂縣公。

translations.literal: Serving Zhou, he was Attendant of the Right of the Crown Prince's Chariot and inherited the title of Duke of Wusui County.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Zhou, he was Attendant of the Right of the Crown Prince's Chariot and inherited the title of Duke of Wusui County.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝踐阼，拜儀同，領交州事，進爵陽城郡公。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne, he was appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs, administered Jiao Province affairs, and was advanced to Duke of Yangcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne, he was appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs, administered Jiao Province affairs, and was promoted to Duke of Yangcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 在州頗有惠政。

translations.literal: In the province he had quite benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: In the province he showed quite benevolent policies.

sentences.zh: 轉驃騎將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 伐陳之役，從宜陽公王世積出九江道，破陳師，進拔江州。

translations.literal: In the campaign against Chen he followed Duke of Yiyang Wang Shiji out through the Jiujiang route, defeated Chen forces, and advanced to capture Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Chen he followed Wang Shiji, Duke of Yiyang, out through the Jiujiang route, defeated Chen forces, and advanced to capture Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 文帝大悅，下詔慰勉之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen was greatly pleased and issued an edict to comfort and encourage him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen was greatly pleased and issued an edict to comfort and encourage him.

sentences.zh: 進位上開府。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Senior Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Senior Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋拜蘄州刺史，遷蘄州總管，徵拜左領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Qi Province, transferred to Area Commander of Qi Province, and summoned to serve as General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Governor of Qi Province, transferred to Area Commander of Qi Province, and summoned to serve as General of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 復以行軍總管從晉王廣破突厥于靈武。

translations.literal: Again as Campaign Commander he followed Prince of Jin Yang Guang and defeated the Turks at Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: Again as Campaign Commander he followed Prince of Jin Yang Guang and defeated the Turks at Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 遷右衛將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 仁壽中，率兵屯弘化以備胡。

translations.literal: During Renshou he led troops to garrison at Honghua to guard against the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: During Renshou he led troops to garrison at Honghua to guard against the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 煬帝時在東宮，遺祥書，論舊行兵時事，申以恩旨。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang was in the Eastern Palace he sent Xiang a letter discussing old military affairs and expressing imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang was in the Eastern Palace he sent Xiang a letter discussing old military affairs and expressing imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 祥為書陳謝。

translations.literal: Xiang submitted a memorial in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang submitted a memorial in thanks.

sentences.zh: 太子甚親遇之。

translations.literal: The crown prince treated him with great intimacy and favor.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince treated him with great intimacy and favor.

sentences.zh: 及即帝位，漢王諒作亂，遣其將綦母良自滏口徇黎陽，塞白馬津，餘公理自太行下河內。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, Prince of Han Liang rebelled and sent his generals Qimu Liang from Fukou to sweep toward Liyang and block Baima Ford, and Yu Gongli from the Taihang Mountains down into Henei.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne, Prince of Han Liang rebelled and sent his generals Qimu Liang from Fukou to sweep toward Liyang and block Baima Ford, and Yu Gongli from the Taihang Mountains down into Henei.

sentences.zh: 帝以祥為行軍總管，軍于河陰，久不得濟。

translations.literal: The emperor made Xiang Campaign Commander; his army was at Heyin and for a long time could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Xiang Campaign Commander. His army was at Heyin and for a long time could not cross.

sentences.zh: 祥謂軍吏曰；

translations.literal: Xiang said to his army officers:
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said to his army officers,

sentences.zh: '餘公理輕而無謀，又新得志，謂其眾可恃，恃眾必驕。

translations.literal: 'Yu Gongli is light-minded and without stratagem, and having just gained his wish he considers his masses dependable; relying on numbers he must be arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: 'Yu Gongli is light-minded and without stratagem, and having just gained his wish he considers his masses dependable. Relying on numbers he must be arrogant.

sentences.zh: 且河北人先不習兵，所謂擁市人而戰，不足圖也。」

translations.literal: Moreover the people of Hebei are not accustomed to warfare by nature—what is called fighting with market crowds—and are not worth planning against."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the people of Hebei are not accustomed to warfare by nature—what is called fighting with market crowds—and are not worth planning against."

sentences.zh: 乃令軍中修攻具。

translations.literal: He then ordered the army to prepare siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the army to prepare siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 公理使諜知之，果屯兵于河陽內城以備。

translations.literal: Gongli had spies learn of this and indeed stationed troops in the inner city of Heyang to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Gongli had spies learn of this and indeed stationed troops in the inner city of Heyang to prepare.

sentences.zh: 祥於是艤船南岸，公理聚甲當之。

translations.literal: Xiang then moored his boats on the south bank; Gongli gathered armor to oppose him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang then moored his boats on the south bank. Gongli gathered armor to oppose him.

sentences.zh: 祥乃簡精銳，於下流潛度。

translations.literal: Xiang then selected picked troops and secretly crossed downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang then selected picked troops and secretly crossed downstream.

sentences.zh: 公理拒之，未成列，祥縱擊大破之。

translations.literal: Gongli resisted but had not yet formed ranks; Xiang unleashed his attack and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Gongli resisted but had not yet formed ranks. Xiang unleashed his attack and inflicted a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 東趣黎陽，討綦良。

translations.literal: He marched east toward Liyang to suppress Qimu Liang.
translations.idiomatic: He marched east toward Liyang to suppress Qimu Liang.

sentences.zh: 綦良棄軍走，其眾大潰。

translations.literal: Qimu Liang abandoned his army and fled; his masses were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Qimu Liang abandoned his army and fled and his masses were greatly routed.

sentences.zh: 進位上大將軍，賜縑彩七千段、女妓十人、良馬二十疋。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand General, granted seven thousand bolts of colored silk, ten female entertainers, and twenty fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand General and granted seven thousand bolts of colored silk, ten female entertainers, and twenty fine horses.

sentences.zh: 轉太僕卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Coachmanship.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Coachmanship.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗賜祥詩曰：「伯炯朝寄重，夏侯親遇深，貴耳唯聞古，賤目詎知今？

translations.literal: The emperor once granted Xiang a poem saying: "Bo Jiong's court trust is weighty, Xiahou's personal favor is deep; the noble ear hears only antiquity, the base eye—how could it know the present?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once granted Xiang a poem saying, "Bo Jiong's court trust is weighty, Xiahou's personal favor is deep; the noble ear hears only antiquity, the base eye—how could it know the present?

sentences.zh: 早摽勁草質，久有背淮心，掃逆黎山外，振旅河之陰。

translations.literal: Early you showed the quality of tough grass; long you harbored a heart turned from the Huai; sweeping rebels beyond Mount Li, marshaling troops north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Early you showed the quality of tough grass; long you harbored a heart turned from the Huai; sweeping rebels beyond Mount Li, marshaling troops north of the river.

sentences.zh: 功已書王府，留情太僕箴。」

translations.literal: Merit is already recorded in the princely archives; my regard remains with the Minister of Coachmanship's admonition."
translations.idiomatic: Merit is already recorded in the princely archives; my regard remains with the Minister of Coachmanship's admonition.

sentences.zh: 祥上表辭謝。

translations.literal: Xiang submitted a memorial declining thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang submitted a memorial declining thanks.

sentences.zh: 帝手詔曰：「昔歲勞公，問罪河朔。

translations.literal: The emperor wrote a personal edict saying: "Last year I troubled you, sir, to ask guilt of Heshuo.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote a personal edict saying, "Last year I troubled you to ask guilt of Heshuo.

sentences.zh: 賊爾日塞兩關之路，據倉阻河，公竭誠奮勇，一舉而克。

translations.literal: The rebels that day blocked the roads of the two passes, held the granaries and blocked the river; you, sir, exhausted your loyalty and fought with courage and took them in one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels that day blocked the roads of the two passes, held the granaries and blocked the river. You exhausted your loyalty and fought with courage and took them in one stroke.

sentences.zh: 故聊示所懷，亦何謝也。」

translations.literal: Therefore I briefly show my feelings—what need for thanks?"
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I briefly show my feelings—what need for thanks?"

sentences.zh: 尋遷鴻臚卿，從征吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Minister of Ceremonial Reception and followed the campaign against the Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Minister of Ceremonial Reception and followed the campaign against the Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 祥出玉門道，擊虜破之。

translations.literal: Xiang went out through the Yumen route, struck the barbarians and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang went out through the Yumen route, struck the barbarians and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 進位右光祿大夫，拜右驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Brightness of the Right and appointed Grand General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Brightness of the Right and appointed Grand General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 及征遼東，出蹋頓道，不利，由是除名。

translations.literal: When the campaign against Liaodong began, he went out through the Tadun route with unfavorable results and thereby had his name struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign against Liaodong began, he went out through the Tadun route with unfavorable results and thereby had his name struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 俄拜燕郡太守，被賊高開道所圍，城陷，開道甚禮之。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Governor of Yan Commandery, was besieged by the bandit Gao Kaidao, the city fell, and Kaidao treated him with great courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Governor of Yan Commandery, was besieged by the bandit Gao Kaidao, the city fell, and Kaidao treated him with great courtesy.

sentences.zh: 會開道與羅藝通和，送祥於涿群，卒于塗。

translations.literal: When Kaidao made peace with Luo Yi, he sent Xiang to Zhuo Commandery and Xiang died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: When Kaidao made peace with Luo Yi, he sent Xiang to Zhuo Commandery and Xiang died on the road.

sentences.zh: 子義隆，永年令。

translations.literal: His son Yilong was Magistrate of Yongnian.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yilong was Magistrate of Yongnian.

sentences.zh: 祥弟雲，字世高，亦以父勳賜爵武平縣公。

translations.literal: Xiang's younger brother Yun, courtesy name Shigao, also because of his father's merit was enfeoffed as Duke of Wuping County.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's younger brother Yun, courtesy name Shigao, also because of his father's merit was enfeoffed as Duke of Wuping County.

sentences.zh: 歷位司織下大夫、儀同大將軍、萊州刺史。

translations.literal: He successively held the positions of Grand Master of the Weaving Office, General with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Lai Province.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Grand Master of the Weaving Office, General with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Lai Province.

sentences.zh: 雲弟威，字世儀，亦以父勳賜爵武當縣公。

translations.literal: Yun's younger brother Wei, courtesy name Shiyi, also because of his father's merit was enfeoffed as Duke of Wudang County.
translations.idiomatic: Yun's younger brother Wei, courtesy name Shiyi, also because of his father's merit was enfeoffed as Duke of Wudang County.

sentences.zh: 權景宣，字暉遠，天水顯親人也。

translations.literal: Quan Jingxuan, courtesy name Huiyuan, was a man of Xianqin in Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Jingxuan, courtesy name Huiyuan, was a native of Xianqin in Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 父曇騰，魏隴西郡守，贈秦州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Tanteng was Governor of Longxi Commandery under Wei and was posthumously granted Governor of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tanteng was Governor of Longxi Commandery under Wei and was posthumously granted Governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 景宣少聰悟，有氣俠，宗党皆歎異之。

translations.literal: Jingxuan from youth was clever and perceptive, possessed bold chivalry, and his clan all sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan from youth was clever and perceptive, possessed bold chivalry, and his clan all sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 年十七，魏行台蕭寶夤見而奇之，表為輕車將軍。

translations.literal: At age seventeen the Wei Grand Commissioner Xiao Baoyin saw him and was impressed, memorializing to appoint him General of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: At age seventeen the Wei Grand Commissioner Xiao Baoyin saw him and was impressed and memorialized to appoint him General of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 及寶夤敗，景宣歸鄉里。

translations.literal: When Baoyin was defeated, Jingxuan returned to his home region.
translations.idiomatic: When Baoyin was defeated, Jingxuan returned to his home region.

sentences.zh: 周文帝平隴右，擢為行台郎中。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Zhou pacified Longyou, he was promoted to Bureau Attendant of the Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Zhou pacified Longyou, he was promoted to Bureau Attendant of the Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 孝武四遷，授鎮遠將軍、步兵校尉，加平西將軍、秦州大中正。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu promoted him four times, granting General of Pacifying the Distance, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, additionally General of Pacifying the West, and Chief Rectifier of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu promoted him four times, granting General of Pacifying the Distance, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, additionally General of Pacifying the West, and Chief Rectifier of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 大統初，轉祠部郎中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong he was transferred to Bureau Attendant of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Datong he was transferred to Bureau Attendant of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 景宣曉兵權，有智略。

translations.literal: Jingxuan understood military authority and had wisdom and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan understood military authority and had wisdom and stratagem.

sentences.zh: 從周文拔弘農，破沙苑，皆先登陷陣。

translations.literal: Following Zhou Wen he captured Hongnong and defeated Shayuan, in each being first to ascend and break the enemy lines.
translations.idiomatic: Following Emperor Wen he captured Hongnong and defeated Shayuan, in each being first to ascend and break the enemy lines.

sentences.zh: 轉外兵郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Bureau Attendant of External Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Bureau Attendant of External Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 從開府於謹援洛陽，景宣督課糧儲，軍以周濟。

translations.literal: Following the Director of the Department of State Affairs Yu Jin in relief of Luoyang, Jingxuan supervised the assessment of grain stores and the army was thereby supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Following Yu Jin, Director of the Department of State Affairs, in relief of Luoyang, Jingxuan supervised the assessment of grain stores and the army was thereby supplied.

sentences.zh: 時初復洛陽，將修繕宮室，景宣率徒三千，先出采運。

translations.literal: At that time Luoyang had just been recovered and palace halls were about to be repaired; Jingxuan led three thousand laborers and went out first to gather and transport materials.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Luoyang had just been recovered and palace halls were about to be repaired. Jingxuan led three thousand laborers and went out first to gather and transport materials.

sentences.zh: 會東魏兵至，司州牧元季海等以眾少拔還，屬城悉叛，道路擁塞。

translations.literal: It happened that Eastern Wei troops arrived; Governor of Si Province Yuan Jihai and others, finding their numbers too few, withdrew, subordinate cities all rebelled, and the roads were blocked and congested.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Eastern Wei troops arrived. Governor of Si Province Yuan Jihai and others, finding their numbers too few, withdrew, subordinate cities all rebelled, and the roads were blocked and congested.

sentences.zh: 景宣將二十騎且戰且走，從騎略盡。

translations.literal: Jingxuan with twenty horsemen fought as they fled; his followers were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan with twenty horsemen fought as they fled. His followers were nearly all gone.

sentences.zh: 景宣輕馬突圍，手斬數級，馳而獲免，因投人家自匿。

translations.literal: Jingxuan on a light horse broke through the encirclement, personally beheaded several enemies, galloped and escaped, and then hid himself in a commoner's house.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan on a light horse broke through the encirclement, personally beheaded several enemies, galloped and escaped, and then hid himself in a commoner's house.

sentences.zh: 景宣以久藏非計，乃偽作周文書，招募得五百餘人，保據宜陽，聲言大軍續至。

translations.literal: Jingxuan considered long concealment no plan and therefore forged a document in Zhou Wen's name, recruited more than five hundred men, held and defended Yiyang, and proclaimed that a great army would follow.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan considered long concealment no plan and therefore forged a document in Emperor Wen's name, recruited more than five hundred men, held and defended Yiyang, and proclaimed that a great army would follow.

sentences.zh: 東魏將段琛等率眾至九曲，憚景宣不敢進。

translations.literal: The Eastern Wei generals Duan Chen and others led masses to Jiuqu but feared Jingxuan and did not dare advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Wei generals Duan Chen and others led masses to Jiuqu but feared Jingxuan and did not dare advance.

sentences.zh: 景宣恐琛審其虛實，乃將腹心自隨，詐云迎軍，因得西遁。

translations.literal: Jingxuan feared Chen would investigate his true situation and therefore took his trusted men with him, falsely claiming to welcome the army, and thereby escaped west.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan feared Chen would investigate his true situation and therefore took his trusted men with him, falsely claiming to welcome the army, and thereby escaped west.

sentences.zh: 與儀同李延孫相會，攻拔孔城。

translations.literal: He joined the Director of the Department of State Affairs Li Yansun and attacked and captured Kong City.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Li Yansun, Director of the Department of State Affairs, and attacked and captured Kong City.

sentences.zh: 洛陽以南，尋亦來附。

translations.literal: South of Luoyang, before long, they also came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: South of Luoyang, before long, they also came to submit.

sentences.zh: 周文即留景宣守張白塢，節度東南義軍。

translations.literal: Zhou Wen then left Jingxuan to guard Zhangbaiwu and direct the righteous armies of the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen then left Jingxuan to guard Zhangbaiwu and direct the righteous armies of the southeast.

sentences.zh: 東魏將王元軌入洛，景宣與延孫等擊走之，以功授大行台左丞。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Wei general Wang Yuangui entered Luoyang, Jingxuan together with Yansun and others drove him off and for his merit was appointed Left Assistant of the Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eastern Wei general Wang Yuangui entered Luoyang, Jingxuan together with Yansun and others drove him off and for his merit was appointed Left Assistant of the Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 進屯宜陽，攻襄城，拔之，獲郡守王洪顯。

translations.literal: He advanced and encamped at Yiyang, attacked Xiang City, captured it, and took the Governor Wang Hongxian.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced and encamped at Yiyang, attacked Xiang City, captured it, and took Governor Wang Hongxian.

sentences.zh: 周文嘉之，徵入朝。

translations.literal: Zhou Wen praised him and summoned him to court.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen praised him and summoned him to court.

sentences.zh: 錄前後功，封顯親縣男，除南陽郡守。

translations.literal: His past and present merit was recorded; he was enfeoffed as Baron of Xianqin County and appointed Governor of Nanyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His past and present merit was recorded. He was enfeoffed as Baron of Xianqin County and appointed Governor of Nanyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 郡鄰敵境，舊制發人守防三十五處，多廢農桑，而奸宄猶作。

translations.literal: The commandery bordered enemy territory; under the old system men were sent to garrison thirty-five places, greatly wasting farming and sericulture, yet villains still acted.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery bordered enemy territory. Under the old system men were sent to garrison thirty-five places, greatly wasting farming and sericulture, yet villains still acted.

sentences.zh: 景宣至，並除之，唯修起城樓，多備器械，寇盜斂跡，人得肄業焉。

translations.literal: When Jingxuan arrived he abolished all of them, only repaired and raised tower gates, and prepared many weapons; bandits and robbers withdrew and the people were able to pursue their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingxuan arrived he abolished all of them, only repaired and raised tower gates, and prepared many weapons. Bandits and robbers withdrew and the people were able to pursue their occupations.

sentences.zh: 百姓稱之，立碑頌德。

translations.literal: The common people praised him and erected a stele to extol his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The common people praised him and erected a stele to extol his virtue.

sentences.zh: 周文特賞粟帛，以旌其能。

translations.literal: Zhou Wen specially rewarded him with grain and cloth to honor his ability.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen specially rewarded him with grain and cloth to honor his ability.

sentences.zh: 遷廣州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 侯景舉河南來附，景宣從僕射王思政經略應接。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing offered Henan to submit, Jingxuan followed Vice Director Wang Sizheng in planning the response.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing offered Henan to submit, Jingxuan followed Vice Director Wang Sizheng in planning the response.

sentences.zh: 既而侯景南叛，恐東魏復有其地，以景宣為大都督、豫州刺史，鎮樂口。

translations.literal: Before long Hou Jing rebelled south; fearing Eastern Wei would recover the territory, Jingxuan was made Grand Commander and Governor of Yu Province, garrisoning Lekou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Hou Jing rebelled south. Fearing Eastern Wei would recover the territory, Jingxuan was made Grand Commander and Governor of Yu Province, garrisoning Lekou.

sentences.zh: 東魏亦遣張伯德為刺史。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei also sent Zhang Bode as governor.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei also sent Zhang Bode as governor.

sentences.zh: 伯德令其將劉貴平率其戍卒及山蠻，屢來攻逼。

translations.literal: Bode ordered his general Liu Guiping to lead his garrison troops and mountain barbarians and repeatedly come to attack and press.
translations.idiomatic: Bode ordered his general Liu Guiping to lead his garrison troops and mountain barbarians and repeatedly come to attack and press.

sentences.zh: 景宣珍不滿千人，隨機奮擊，貴平乃退走。

translations.literal: Jingxuan had barely a thousand men but struck according to circumstances with fierce effort and Guiping then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan had barely a thousand men but struck according to circumstances with fierce effort and Guiping then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 進授使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was further granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: He was further granted Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 潁川陷後，周文以樂口等諸城道路阻絕，悉令拔還。

translations.literal: After Yingchuan fell, Zhou Wen because the roads to cities such as Lekou were cut off ordered all to be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: After Yingchuan fell, Emperor Wen because the roads to cities such as Lekou were cut off ordered all to be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 襄州刺史杞秀以狼狽獲罪。

translations.literal: Governor of Xiang Province Qi Xiu was punished for his disgraceful retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Xiang Province Qi Xiu was punished for his disgraceful retreat.

sentences.zh: 景宣號令嚴明，戎旅整肅，所部全濟，獨被優賞。

translations.literal: Jingxuan's orders were strict and clear, his army disciplined and orderly, his command entirely preserved, and he alone received special reward.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan's orders were strict and clear, his army disciplined and orderly, his command entirely preserved, and he alone received special reward.

sentences.zh: 仍留鎮荊州，委以鵶南之事。

translations.literal: He was still left to garrison Jing Province and entrusted with affairs south of the Ya.
translations.idiomatic: He was still left to garrison Jing Province and entrusted with affairs south of the Ya.

sentences.zh: 初，梁岳陽王蕭詧將以襄陽歸朝，仍勒兵攻梁元帝於江陵。

translations.literal: At first the Prince of Yueyang of Liang, Xiao Cha, was about to offer Xiangyang to the court but still led troops to attack Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Prince of Yueyang of Liang, Xiao Cha, was about to offer Xiangyang to the court but still led troops to attack Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 詧叛將杜岸乘虛襲之。

translations.literal: Cha's rebel general Du An took advantage of the moment to raid him.
translations.idiomatic: Cha's rebel general Du An took advantage of the moment to raid him.

sentences.zh: 景宣乃率騎三千助詧。

translations.literal: Jingxuan then led three thousand horsemen to aid Cha.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan then led three thousand horsemen to aid Cha.

sentences.zh: 詧因是乃送其妻王氏及子寮入質。

translations.literal: Cha thereupon sent his wife Lady Wang and his son Liao as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Cha thereupon sent his wife Lady Wang and his son Liao as hostages.

sentences.zh: 景宣又與開府楊忠取梁將柳仲禮，拔安陸、隨郡。

translations.literal: Jingxuan again together with the Director of the Department of State Affairs Yang Zhong captured the Liang general Liu Zhongli and took Anlu and Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan again together with Yang Zhong, Director of the Department of State Affairs, captured the Liang general Liu Zhongli and took Anlu and Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，隨州城人吳士英殺刺史黃道玉，因聚為寇。

translations.literal: After a long time the people of Suizhou city, Wu Shiying, killed Governor Huang Daoyu and gathered together as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time the people of Suizhou city, Wu Shiying, killed Governor Huang Daoyu and gathered together as bandits.

sentences.zh: 景宣以英小賊，可以計取之，若聲其罪，恐同惡者眾。

translations.literal: Jingxuan considered Ying a small bandit who could be taken by stratagem; if his crime were proclaimed, he feared those of like evil would be many.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan considered Ying a small bandit who could be taken by stratagem. If his crime were proclaimed, he feared those of like evil would be many.

sentences.zh: 乃與英書，偽稱道玉凶暴，歸功英等。

translations.literal: He then wrote to Ying, falsely claiming Daoyu was cruel and violent and attributing the merit to Ying and the others.
translations.idiomatic: He then wrote to Ying, falsely claiming Daoyu was cruel and violent and attributing the merit to Ying and the others.

sentences.zh: 英等果信之，遂相率而至。

translations.literal: Ying and the others indeed believed this and therefore came one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and the others indeed believed this and therefore came one after another.

sentences.zh: 景宣執而戮之，獲其黨與。

translations.literal: Jingxuan seized and executed them and captured their associates.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan seized and executed them and captured their associates.

sentences.zh: 進攻應城，拔之，獲夏侯珍洽。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Ying City, captured it, and took Xiahou Zhenqia.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to attack Ying City, captured it, and took Xiahou Zhenqia.

sentences.zh: 於是應禮安隨並平。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ying, Li, An, and Sui were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Ying, Li, An, and Sui were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 朝議以景宣威行南服，乃授並安肆郢新應六州諸軍事、并州刺史。

translations.literal: The court deliberated that because Jingxuan's authority extended through the southern regions, he was granted Commander of Military Affairs in the Six Provinces of Bing, An, Si, Ying, Xin, and Ying, and Governor of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated that because Jingxuan's authority extended through the southern regions, he was granted Commander of Military Affairs in the Six Provinces of Bing, An, Si, Ying, Xin, and Ying, and Governor of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 尋進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，加侍中，兼督江、北司二州諸軍事，進爵為伯。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry, Director of the Department of State Affairs with equal ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, additionally made Palace Attendant, concurrently Commander of Military Affairs in the Two Provinces of Jiang and Bei Si, and advanced in rank to baron.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to General of Agile Cavalry, Director of the Department of State Affairs with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies, additionally appointed Palace Attendant, concurrently Commander of Military Affairs in the Two Provinces of Jiang and Bei Si, and advanced in rank to baron.

sentences.zh: 唐州蠻田魯嘉自號豫州伯，引致齊兵，大為人害。

translations.literal: The Tang Province barbarian Tian Lujia styled himself Baron of Yu Province and brought in Qi troops, greatly harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Province barbarian Tian Lujia styled himself Baron of Yu Province and brought in Qi troops, greatly harming the people.

sentences.zh: 景宣又破之，獲魯嘉，以其地為郡。

translations.literal: Jingxuan again defeated him, captured Lujia, and made his territory into a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan again defeated him, captured Lujia, and made his territory into a commandery.

sentences.zh: 轉安州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of An Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of An Province.

sentences.zh: 梁定州刺史李洪遠初款後叛，景宣惡其懷貳，密襲破之，虜其家口及部眾。

translations.literal: Li Hongyuan, Governor of Ding Province of Liang, at first submitted in good faith but later rebelled; Jingxuan hated his double-dealing, secretly raided and defeated him, and captured his family and followers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongyuan, Governor of Ding Province of Liang, at first submitted in good faith but later rebelled. Jingxuan hated his double-dealing, secretly raided and defeated him, and captured his family and followers.

sentences.zh: 洪遠脫身走免。

translations.literal: Hongyuan escaped and got away.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyuan escaped and got away.

sentences.zh: 自是酋帥懾服，無敢叛者。

translations.literal: From then on the chieftains were awed and submitted and none dared rebel.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the chieftains were awed and submitted and none dared rebel.

sentences.zh: 燕公於謹征江陵，景宣別破梁司空陸法和司馬羊亮于溳水。

translations.literal: When Duke of Yan Yu Jin campaigned against Jiangling, Jingxuan separately defeated Liang Minister of Works Lu Fahe and Sima Yang Liang at the Yun River.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Jin, Duke of Yan, campaigned against Jiangling, Jingxuan separately defeated Liang Minister of Works Lu Fahe and Sima Yang Liang at the Yun River.

sentences.zh: 又遣別帥攻拔魯山。

translations.literal: He also sent a separate commander to attack and capture Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a separate commander to attack and capture Lushan.

sentences.zh: 多造舟艋，益張旗幟，臨江欲度，以懼梁人。

translations.literal: He built many boats and expanded banners and flags, intending to cross the river to frighten the Liang people.
translations.idiomatic: He built many boats and expanded banners and flags, intending to cross the river to frighten the Liang people.

sentences.zh: 梁將王琳在湘州，景宣遺書喻以禍福，琳遂遣長史席壑因景宣請舉州款附。

translations.literal: The Liang general Wang Lin was in Xiang Province; Jingxuan sent a letter explaining fortune and disaster, and Lin then sent his Chief Administrator Xi He through Jingxuan to request submission of the entire province.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang general Wang Lin was in Xiang Province. Jingxuan sent a letter explaining fortune and disaster, and Lin then sent his Chief Administrator Xi He through Jingxuan to request submission of the entire province.

sentences.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，徵為司憲中大夫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, Jingxuan was summoned as Grand Master of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, Jingxuan was summoned as Grand Master of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 尋除基鄀硤平四州五防諸軍事、江陵防主，加大將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Commander of Military Affairs in the Four Garrisons of Ji, E, Xia, and Ping and Walled Commander of Jiangling, and was additionally made Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Commander of Military Affairs in the Four Garrisons of Ji, E, Xia, and Ping and Walled Commander of Jiangling, and was additionally made Grand General.

sentences.zh: 保定四年，晉公護東討，景宣別略河南。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoding Duke of Jin Hu campaigned east; Jingxuan separately overran Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Baoding Duke of Jin Hu campaigned east. Jingxuan separately overran Henan.

sentences.zh: 齊豫州刺史王士良、永州刺史世怡並以城降。

translations.literal: Qi Governor of Yu Province Wang Shiliang and Governor of Yong Province Shi Yi both surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Governor of Yu Province Wang Shiliang and Governor of Yong Province Shi Yi both surrendered their cities.

sentences.zh: 景宣以開府謝徹守永州，開府郭彥守豫州，以士良、世怡及降卒一千人歸諸京師。

translations.literal: Jingxuan had the Director of the Department of State Affairs Xie Che guard Yong Province and the Director of the Department of State Affairs Guo Yan guard Yu Province, and sent Shiliang, Shi Yi, and one thousand surrendered soldiers to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan had Xie Che, Director of the Department of State Affairs, guard Yong Province and Guo Yan, Director of the Department of State Affairs, guard Yu Province, and sent Shiliang, Shi Yi, and one thousand surrendered soldiers to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋而洛陽不守，乃棄二州，拔其將士而還。

translations.literal: Before long Luoyang could not be held and he therefore abandoned the two provinces, withdrew his generals and soldiers, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Luoyang could not be held and he therefore abandoned the two provinces, withdrew his generals and soldiers, and returned.

sentences.zh: 至昌州而羅陽蠻反，景宣回軍破之。

translations.literal: At Chang Province the Luoyang barbarians rebelled; Jingxuan turned his army and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At Chang Province the Luoyang barbarians rebelled. Jingxuan turned his army and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 還次霸上，晉公護親迎勞之。

translations.literal: On return he stopped at Bashang; Duke of Jin Hu personally came to welcome and comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: On return he stopped at Bashang. Duke of Jin Hu personally came to welcome and comfort him.

sentences.zh: 天和初，授荊州刺史，總管十七州諸軍事，進爵千金郡公。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianhe he was appointed Governor of Jing Province, Commander of Military Affairs in Seventeen Provinces, and advanced to Duke of Qianjin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianhe he was appointed Governor of Jing Province, Commander of Military Affairs in Seventeen Provinces, and promoted to Duke of Qianjin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 陳湘州刺史華皎舉州款附，表請援兵。

translations.literal: Hua Jiao, Governor of Xiang Province of Chen, offered his province in submission and memorialized requesting relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Jiao, Governor of Xiang Province of Chen, offered his province in submission and memorialized requesting relief troops.

sentences.zh: 敕景宣統水軍與皎俱下。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jingxuan to command the navy and descend together with Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jingxuan to command the navy and descend together with Jiao.

sentences.zh: 景宣到夏口，陳人已至。

translations.literal: When Jingxuan reached Xiakou, the Chen men had already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingxuan reached Xiakou, the Chen men had already arrived.

sentences.zh: 而景宣以任遇隆重，遂驕傲縱恣，多自矜伐，兼納賄貨，指麾節度，朝出夕改。

translations.literal: But Jingxuan, because his appointment and favor were weighty, then became arrogant and self-indulgent, greatly praising himself, also accepted bribes, and his commands and dispositions changed from morning to evening.
translations.idiomatic: But Jingxuan, because his appointment and favor were weighty, became arrogant and self-indulgent, greatly praised himself, also accepted bribes, and his commands and dispositions changed from morning to evening.

sentences.zh: 將士憤怒，莫肯用命。

translations.literal: Generals and soldiers were angry and unwilling to obey orders.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and soldiers were angry and unwilling to obey orders.

sentences.zh: 及水軍始交，一時奔北，戰艦器仗，略無孑遺。

translations.literal: When the navies first joined battle, they fled north all at once; warships and weapons were nearly all lost.
translations.idiomatic: When the navies first joined battle, they fled north all at once. Warships and weapons were nearly all lost.

sentences.zh: 時衛公直總督諸軍，以景宣負敗，欲繩以軍法。

translations.literal: At that time Duke of Wei Zhi was overall commander of the armies and, because Jingxuan had been defeated, wished to punish him by military law.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Duke of Wei Zhi was overall commander of the armies and, because Jingxuan had been defeated, wished to punish him by military law.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不忍加罪，遣使就軍赦之。

translations.literal: The court could not bear to add guilt and sent envoys to the army to pardon him.
translations.idiomatic: The court could not bear to add guilt and sent envoys to the army to pardon him.

sentences.zh: 尋遇疾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he fell ill and died.

sentences.zh: 贈河、渭、鄯三州刺史，諡曰恭。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Governor of the Three Provinces of He, Wei, and Shan; posthumous title Gong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Governor of the Three Provinces of He, Wei, and Shan, with the posthumous name Gong, "Respectful."

sentences.zh: 子如璋嗣，位至開府、膠州刺史。

translations.literal: His son Ruzhang succeeded and rose to Director of the Department of State Affairs and Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ruzhang succeeded to the line and rose to Director of the Department of State Affairs and Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 如璋弟仕玠，儀同大將軍、廣川縣侯。

translations.literal: Ruzhang's younger brother Shijie was General with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and Marquis of Guangchuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Ruzhang's younger brother Shijie was General with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies and Marquis of Guangchuan County.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王盟始以親黨升朝，終而才能進達，勤宣運始，位列周行，實參跡于功臣，蓋弗由於恩澤。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Wang Meng at first rose in court through kinship, but in the end advanced through talent and ability; diligently proclaiming the beginning of the dynasty's fortune, he took his place in the Zhou ranks, truly sharing in the traces of meritorious ministers—this was surely not due to favor alone.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Wang Meng at first rose in court through kinship, but in the end advanced through talent and ability. Diligently proclaiming the beginning of the dynasty's fortune, he took his place in the Zhou ranks, truly sharing in the traces of meritorious ministers—this was surely not due to favor alone.

sentences.zh: 誼文武奇才，以剛正見忌，有隋受命，郁為名臣，末路披猖，信有終之克鮮。

translations.literal: Yi was a rare talent in both civil and military affairs, yet was resented for his upright firmness; when Sui received the Mandate he flourished as a famous minister, but his final years were turbulent—truly, few maintain their virtue to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was a rare talent in both civil and military affairs, yet was resented for his upright firmness. When Sui received the Mandate he flourished as a famous minister, but his final years were turbulent—truly, few maintain their virtue to the end.

sentences.zh: 獨孤信威申南服，化洽西州，信著遐方，光昭鄰國，雖不免其身，慶延於後，三代外戚，何其盛歟！

translations.literal: Dugu Xin's authority extended through the southern regions and his transforming influence reached the western provinces; his trustworthiness was known in distant lands and his brilliance shone in neighboring states. Although he did not escape death himself, blessing extended to his descendants—three generations of imperial in-laws; how grand!
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Xin's authority extended through the southern regions and his transforming influence reached the western provinces. His trustworthiness was known in distant lands and his brilliance shone in neighboring states. Although he did not escape death himself, blessing extended to his descendants—three generations of imperial in-laws. How grand!

sentences.zh: 竇熾儀錶魁梧，器識雄遠，入參朝政，則嘉謀屢陳，出總籓條，則惠政斯洽。

translations.literal: Dou Chi had an imposing bearing and far-reaching vision and insight; entering court to participate in government he repeatedly offered excellent plans, and going out to command frontier regions his benevolent policies were harmoniously applied.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Chi had an imposing bearing and far-reaching vision and insight. Entering court to participate in government he repeatedly offered excellent plans, and going out to command frontier regions his benevolent policies were harmoniously applied.

sentences.zh: 毅忠蕭奉上，溫恭接下，茂實彰於本朝，義聲播於殊俗。

translations.literal: Yi was loyal in serving his superiors and warm and respectful toward his subordinates; solid merit was displayed in the native court and righteous reputation spread among foreign peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was loyal in serving his superiors and warm and respectful toward his subordinates. Solid merit was displayed in the native court and righteous reputation spread among foreign peoples.

sentences.zh: 並以國華人望，論道當官，榮映一時，慶流來葉。

translations.literal: All were men of national glory and public esteem who discussed the Way while holding office; their honor illuminated a generation and their blessing flowed to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: All were men of national glory and public esteem who discussed the Way while holding office. Their honor illuminated a generation and their blessing flowed to later generations.

sentences.zh: 及熾遲疑勸進，有送故之心，雖王公恨恨，何以加此。

translations.literal: When Chi hesitated over urging the founding of the dynasty he showed a heart that sent off the old regime; though kings and dukes were resentful, how could they surpass this?
translations.idiomatic: When Chi hesitated over urging the founding of the dynasty he showed a heart that sent off the old regime. Though kings and dukes were resentful, how could they surpass this?

sentences.zh: 榮定以功懋賞，以勞定國，保其祿位，貽厥子孫，盛矣。

translations.literal: Rongding was rewarded for his merit and settled the state through his labors, preserved his rank and emolument and bequeathed them to his descendants—how flourishing!
translations.idiomatic: Rongding was rewarded for his merit and settled the state through his labors, preserved his rank and emolument and bequeathed them to his descendants—how flourishing!

sentences.zh: 賀蘭祥、叱列伏龜、閻慶等雖階緣戚屬，各以功名自終，而毗製造之功，亦足傳于後葉。

translations.literal: Helan Xiang, Chiliefu Gui, Yan Qing, and others, though they rose through kinship connections, each ended with merit and fame to their names; and Pi's achievements in manufacture are also sufficient to pass to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: Helan Xiang, Chiliefu Gui, Yan Qing, and others, though they rose through kinship connections, each ended with merit and fame to their names. Pi's achievements in manufacture are also sufficient to pass to later generations.

sentences.zh: 史甯、權景宣並以將帥之才，受內外之寵，總戎薄伐，著克敵之功，布政蒞人，垂稱職之譽，若此者，豈非有國之良翰歟！

translations.literal: Shi Ning and Quan Jingxuan both possessed the talent of generals and received favor inside and outside the court; commanding armies on minor campaigns they achieved merit in defeating the enemy, and administering government and overseeing the people they won praise for fulfilling their duties—were such men not fine pillars of the state!
translations.idiomatic: Shi Ning and Quan Jingxuan both possessed the talent of generals and received favor inside and outside the court. Commanding armies on minor campaigns they achieved merit in defeating the enemy, and administering government and overseeing the people they won praise for fulfilling their duties—were such men not fine pillars of the state!

sentences.zh: 然而史在末年，貨財虧其雅志，權亦晚節矜驕，喪其威聲，惜矣。

translations.literal: Yet Shi in his later years, through wealth and goods, diminished his lofty aspirations, and Quan in his final years through pride and arrogance lost his prestige—regrettable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Shi in his later years, through wealth and goods, diminished his lofty aspirations, and Quan in his final years through pride and arrogance lost his prestige—regrettable.

sentences.zh: 楊諒幹紀，祥獨克之，效亦足稱云爾。

translations.literal: When Yang Liang rebelled against discipline, Xiang alone overcame him; his achievement is also sufficient to be praised.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Liang rebelled against discipline, Xiang alone overcame him. His achievement is also sufficient to be praised.
